Assessment: Element 2 Account Number must be present for the transaction context; 'PAN' means the Element 2 account representation.
Corrected Requirement: Element 2 Account Number present (representation per entry context).

Assessment: Element 2 is character type ANS (24 bytes non-TransArmor, up to 425 bytes TransArmor). Numeric-only holds for a raw keyed PAN, not for track, token or encrypted representations.
Corrected Requirement: Apply numeric-only to a raw keyed PAN; validate track, token and TransArmor representations by their own rules.

Assessment: ATL105 defines no Mastercard BIN/IIN table, and Prompt Code card type 020 does not prove the brand. The only Test Solution BIN rule covers payment-token BIN ranges (Appendix O).
Corrected Requirement: Check the BIN against an approved, versioned Mastercard BIN/IIN source supplied by the BA.

Assessment: ATL105 sets Element 2 maximum lengths by representation, not a Mastercard PAN length. The Test Solution checks 13-19 digits only for payment tokens.
Corrected Requirement: Apply the BA-approved PAN length policy to raw PANs; keep the Element 2 maximum-length check by representation.

Assessment: ATL105 requires a LUHN check only for payment tokens (Appendix O); no raw-PAN check-digit rule is defined.
Corrected Requirement: Apply LUHN to raw PANs only under the BA-approved card-validation policy; keep the token LUHN rule for tokens.

Assessment: Card status is issuer or status-service data, not carried or decided by the ATL105 request. It also duplicates TS-003.
Corrected Requirement: Remove from TS-001; check card status once, in TS-003, using a trusted status service.

Assessment: Element 51 is Mail Text Data. For manual entry the MMYY expiry is carried in Element 12 Card Discretionary Block Data.
Corrected Requirement: Element 12 carries the MMYY expiry for a manually entered account.

Assessment: Manual entry prompts for the expiry in MMYY (Section 10.1.1.3), and the Section 10.1.1.1 example 1249 is MMYY. Track-derived host card data stores YYMM after '=' (Section 10.1.8.2).
Corrected Requirement: MMYY for manual entry; track-derived host data uses YYMM.

Assessment: An MMYY expiry is four digits.

Validation (as written): Expiry date not past current date
Assessment: The device validates credit expiry (Section 10.1.1.1) and treats dates up to 1249 as 20xx. ATL105 still requires expiry to be sent for some expired-card authorizations, so a blanket local rejection is not source-backed, and the month-end and time-zone boundary is undefined.
Corrected Requirement: Validate expiry with the 1249 century rule; take the local expired-card outcome from the BA-approved policy.

Assessment: Blocked status comes from the issuer or a status service; the ATL105 request cannot establish it.
Corrected Requirement: Bind a trusted status-service or simulator outcome to the case.

Assessment: Lost/stolen status comes from the issuer or a status service; the ATL105 request cannot establish it.
Corrected Requirement: Bind a trusted status-service or simulator outcome to the case.

Assessment: Expiry is a device check (Section 10.1.1.1) already covered by TS-002.V4, not an issuer card-status check.
Corrected Requirement: Remove from TS-003 and rely on TS-002.

Assessment: ATL105 has no Processing Code element. A credit Purchase/Capture is identified by Element 78 Prompt Code 0020: transaction type 0 (Appendix G) plus financial card type 020 (Appendix E). '020' alone is the card type, not the transaction.
Corrected Requirement: Element 78 Prompt Code = 0020 (transaction type 0, card type 020); 0020 alone does not prove Mastercard.

Validation (as written): Swipe, EMV, Contactless, Manual Entry, E-Commerce values allowed
Assessment: Entry modes are encoded as Appendix J POS Entry Mode values with conditional companion data (Segment 130 for EMV, e-commerce data). The cell lists five labels as one check and gives no wire values.
Corrected Requirement: List the in-scope Appendix J POS Entry Mode codes, one check per mode, with each mode's companion data.

Assessment: The purchase request has no standalone Merchant ID element. The BUYPASS Merchant Number is a component of Element 102 Terminal Identifier (device type, state code, merchant number, device number); Test Solution data use merchant number 123456.
Corrected Requirement: Element 102 Terminal Identifier present with a valid BUYPASS Merchant Number component.

Assessment: Merchant active status is host or merchant configuration; it is not part of the ATL105 request.
Corrected Requirement: Use BA-supplied merchant configuration with active and inactive profiles.

Assessment: The Segment 100 purchase request carries no MCC; MCC is merchant configuration.
Corrected Requirement: Check MCC against the BA-supplied merchant profile.

Assessment: Element 55 Message Format Version Identifier is required in the financial request.
Testable only against a named version, and the workbook never states which ATL105 version it targets.
Corrected Requirement: Element 55 carries the Message Format Version Identifier defined for ATL105 2026-3.

Assessment: Not atomic: the required field set depends on the financial-request layout and the 0020 context.
Corrected Requirement: List the required Segment 100 fields and conditional companion segments for the 0020 request, one check each.

Assessment: Element 63 Number of Segments is required in the financial request.
Element 63 must equal the number of segments actually transmitted.
Segment 100 is required exactly once in the financial request.
Corrected Requirement: Segment 100 present exactly once.

Assessment: Element 24 is Data Type Indicator. Account Number is Element 2.
Corrected Requirement: Element 2 Account Number present.

Assessment: Element 2 is character type ANS. Numeric-only holds for a raw keyed PAN, not for track, token or TransArmor/encrypted representations.
Corrected Requirement: Apply numeric-only to a raw keyed PAN; validate other representations by their own rules.

Assessment: Separator handling depends on the representation: track data splits at '=' (Track 2) or '^' (Track 1), and TransArmor/encrypted values are ANS. A blanket 'no delimiters' rule would reject valid representations.
Corrected Requirement: Check separator handling for the declared account representation.

Assessment: Consistent with Element 2's ANS character type; field separators are structural, not field content. No Test Solution rule checks the Element 2 character set yet.

Segment 100 has no single purchase-amount element; amounts are split into Fuel (41), Nonfuel (58), Tax (99) and Cash (17). The workbook does not say which field or total must be greater than zero, or how zero components are handled.
Corrected Requirement: Name the amount field or total formula (41 + 58 + 99, plus 17 if cash back applies) and its zero rule.

Assessment: Every Segment 100 amount element (41, 58, 99, 17) is character type N.

Segment 100 (Section 12.1) has no currency element. Appendix L currency codes appear only in companion data such as Segment 111 or EMV chip data, so a universal 'currency supplied' check has no field to test.
Corrected Requirement: State the currency source for each entry context (for example EMV data or Segment 111), or drop the check.

Assessment: ATL105 amounts have two assumed decimal places and no decimal point. For Mastercard, Fuel, Nonfuel and Tax allow up to 7 digits and Cash up to 8.
Corrected Requirement: Amounts are unsigned digits with two implied decimals; check each field's maximum length.

Validation (as written): Fuel amount contains total fuel purchase value
Assessment: Element 41 is the total dollar amount of all fuel sold; when discounts or coupons apply it is the net amount after them. Mastercard maximum is 7 digits with two assumed decimals.
Corrected Requirement: Element 41 = total fuel sold, net of fuel discounts and coupons; up to 7 digits, 2 implied decimals.

Assessment: Element 58 is the amount that is not fuel, tax or cash: N, up to 7 digits for Mastercard, two assumed decimals. The cell combines two checks, and an omitted field must be distinguished from a zero value.
Corrected Requirement: Element 58: numeric, up to 7 digits, 2 implied decimals; state whether zero is sent or the field is omitted.

Assessment: Segment 100 Tax Amount is Element 99, character type N (not purchase-card tax Element 74).
Precision is two assumed decimal places, up to 7 digits for Mastercard; the line does not say so.
Corrected Requirement: Element 99: up to 7 digits with 2 implied decimals.

Assessment: Element 17 Cash Amount (cash back) is N, up to 8 digits, valid values 1-99999999.
No rule is named. Element 17 is cash back, and whether cash back is allowed on a Mastercard credit purchase is product policy, not ATL105.
Corrected Requirement: Name the cash-back eligibility rule for Mastercard credit, or remove cash from this scenario.

Assessment: Element 80 is Purchase Code. Sequence Number is Element 86.
Corrected Requirement: Element 86 Sequence Number present.

Assessment: Element 86 is six digits (000001-999999).

Unrelated new transactions get a new sequence, but associated follow-ups (completion, reversal, void, TOR) must reuse the original, so 'unique' needs scoping. No Test Solution chain checks sequence generation across transactions.
Corrected Requirement: Each new, unrelated transaction from a device gets a new Sequence Number; associated follow-up legs reuse the original.

Validation (as written): Purchase, response, reversal, settlement retain same sequence
Assessment: ATL105 requires associated lifecycle legs (completion, reversal, void, TOR) to reuse the original Sequence Number. ATL105 does not define settlement correlation.
Corrected Requirement: Associated follow-up legs reuse the original Element 86; settlement correlation needs the settlement contract.

Assessment: The ATL105 purchase request has no network or brand field, and Prompt Code 0020 does not prove Mastercard. Brand needs trusted BIN evidence.
Corrected Requirement: Establish the Mastercard brand from the BA-approved BIN/brand source.

Assessment: Credit is expressed by Appendix E financial card type 020 in Element 78 positions 2-4; there is no 'Card Program' field.
Corrected Requirement: Element 78 card-type portion = 020 (credit).

Assessment: Purchase/Capture is Appendix G transaction type 0 in Element 78 position 1; this duplicates TS-004.
Corrected Requirement: Element 78 position 1 = 0 (Purchase/Capture).

Validation (as written): Network selection matches Mastercard routing rules
Assessment: Routing is host and network policy; ATL105 does not define Mastercard routing.
Corrected Requirement: Validate against the BA-supplied routing policy with simulator or trace evidence.

Assessment: Not atomic, and it duplicates TS-007.V3. For this purchase the authorization request is the 0020 Purchase/Capture request.
Corrected Requirement: List the required fields for the 0020 request (see TS-007.V3).
Test Solution BRs: BR-RULE-SEG100-R-001 [TRAINED]; BR-SEG100-ID-001 [TRAINED]; BR-SEG100-E55-001 [TRAINED]; BR-SEG100-E63-001 [TRAINED]; BR-RULE-SEG100-R-007 [TRAINED]; BR-APPG-CODE-0 [TRAINED]

Assessment: Not atomic. Checking a response needs the financial-response layout, correlation to the request, and Element 83 read in context, and no response fixtures exist yet.
Corrected Requirement: Parse the financial response, correlate it to the request, and interpret Element 83 for the 0020 context.

Assessment: Element 6 is Approved Amount. The approval identifier is Element 5 Approval Number (six alphanumeric characters).
Corrected Requirement: Element 5 Approval Number received in the approved response.

Assessment: ATL105 requires the original Approval Number only in specific follow-ups (an authorization-only reversal needs the original Approval Number and Sequence Number). ATL105 does not define its use in settlement.
Corrected Requirement: Keep Element 5 for the follow-ups that require it; settlement use needs the settlement contract.

Assessment: Element 83 must be read in context: 0 approves a Purchase/Capture, and F is a partial approval. The line names no code.
Corrected Requirement: Element 83 = 0 for a full Purchase/Capture approval; handle F (partial) separately.

Assessment: Decline codes must be read in the financial context (code 1 approves only communications tests), and a decline must be kept distinct from a timeout or malformed response.
Corrected Requirement: Element 83 decline code for the 0020 context, distinguished from timeout.

Assessment: Element 121 Partial Approval Indicator: value 1 signals support, and value 5 is Amex prepaid only. Partial approval applies to POS Purchase, POS Authorization Only and CAT Authorization Only.
Corrected Requirement: Element 121 = 1 in a supported partial-approval context.

Assessment: Whether the merchant is enabled for partial approval is configuration, not part of the request.
Corrected Requirement: Use BA-supplied merchant and network partial-approval configuration.

Validation (as written): Requested amount vs approved amount calculated
Assessment: With indicator 1, response code F and Element 6 Approved Amount identify a partial approval; the remaining balance is requested minus approved, and any issuer-returned balance is in Segment 112.
Corrected Requirement: On response F, remaining balance = requested amount - Element 6.

Assessment: Section 2.3.1 defines the customer's 30-second response interval. No Test Solution chain checks it yet.
Section 2.3.1 also treats a response received after the 30 seconds as a timeout, and the late response is ignored.
Corrected Requirement: Timeout = no response within 30 seconds, or a late response; ignore the late response.

Assessment: A TOR applies only to eligible originals (Purchase/Capture 0, CAT purchase 4, mail/phone 6 to Z); an authorization-only hold is released by cancellation (S), not a TOR. Route, retry and timing policy remain open.
Corrected Requirement: Generate a TOR only for an eligible timed-out original, keeping its amount and Sequence Number.

Assessment: An eligible TOR reuses the original Element 86 Sequence Number.
Section 2.3.1: the TOR is sent from the same device, ahead of that device's next financial request, or just before settlement if none follows. It is not a global queue.
Corrected Requirement: Send the queued TOR before the next financial request from the same device, or before settlement.

Assessment: A credit receipt has source-required content: merchant name and address, transaction type, account masked to the last four digits, suppressed expiry, date, time, Sequence Number, product details, approval code or decline message, partial-approval balance, and card type ID MC.
Corrected Requirement: Check the Section 10.1.7 receipt content, including card type ID MC, masked account and suppressed expiry.

Assessment: Clearing records are outside ATL105. ATL105 only requires approved authorizations to be cleared or reversed within 24 hours (card present) or 72 hours (card absent), and a 0020 Purchase/Capture is already a capture.
Corrected Requirement: Use the clearing contract, and check the Section 10.1.2.2 clear-or-reverse window.

Assessment: Settlement preparation is outside ATL105. Any retention must respect Section 10.1.8.1: no stored card-read data except account number, expiry and cardholder name, and never full magnetic-stripe data.
Corrected Requirement: Use the settlement contract and retain only permitted data.

Validation (as written): Approval number, sequence number, amounts present
Assessment: Settlement reporting is outside the ATL105 purchase message set; the report format must come from the settlement contract.
Corrected Requirement: Define the settlement report fields in the settlement contract.

Assessment: Retaining full requests would store card-read data that Section 10.1.8.1 prohibits (only account number, expiry and cardholder name may be stored, and never full magnetic-stripe data). BUYPASS provides no electronic journal (Section 9.1); audit design is the customer's.
Corrected Requirement: Log events with masked or permitted fields only, per the BA-approved audit and security policy.
